text: S2-ITG-01 calibration per ADR-003: triage scores injury, drivability and habitability itself, so tenant TR-* rules for those keep only set_complexity (no double-counted add_severity). Theft reported more than 7 days late is a 0.35 fraud cue. Kestrel bands set to the 25/50/75 default. auto_rear_end_injury expectation is now major (one-line rationale in tests/synthetic/index.mjs). e2e pins ctx.clock to each scenario's reportedDate so report lag comes from the scenario.
